name: tool-failure-terminal
body: Replace the existing "if a plan tool errors, read the JSONL directly" fallback (present in the generated implementer and implementation-phase-reviewer) with: on any tool failure, stop immediately and report the exact failure — which tool, what invocation, what it returned/errored, what state — to the coordinator. No retry, no workaround, no reading files, and no diagnosis of the cause (the coordinator decides the cause, don't speculate).
